$schema: Brynzit Console design tokens — extracted from packages/ui/src/styles/theme.css (shared base) and apps/console/app/globals.css (console overrides). Colors are OKLCH strings, used as-is with Tailwind v4 @theme.

meta.notes: Console forces a light theme only (apps/console/app/layout.tsx sets forcedTheme='light'). There is no console dark mode — do not add dark: variants in console code.

status_colors.$note: NOT real design tokens today — these are literal oklch() values inline in ~12 component files (shortlist-table.tsx, candidate-relationship-section.tsx, admin-overview-tab.tsx, ingest-job-card.tsx, etc.), duplicated ad hoc rather than sourced from one place. Recorded here as the de facto palette so new status/category UI (e.g. the planned Interested/Not Interested/Snoozed categorization) reuses these instead of inventing new hex values. Recommend promoting to real @theme tokens (--color-success, --color-warning) before the next feature that adds more status badges.

error_red.note: distinct from --color-destructive (oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325)) — similar hue, different chroma/lightness. Another candidate for de-duplication.

typography.navLabel: text-sm (text-xs for compact Internal Ops links)

spacing.$note: Brynzit spacing aliases exist in theme.css but are NOT the Tailwind --spacing-* namespace (that stays Tailwind v4 default). Use these only where a component explicitly reaches for a named alias; otherwise use ordinary Tailwind spacing scale.

layout.shell: h-screen overflow-hidden root frame; content region min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden; sidebar h-full overflow-y-auto; only main scrolls
